answer: Domain-to-domain reputation exchange is where laundering hides: private deals, opaque rates. Move all exchange onto a public jetty: quartz-locked windows twice an epoch, with transparent rate books computed from the prior cycle's verified volumes. Nobody exchanges standing through private bridges anymore; every conversion walks the jetty in daylight, on a schedule no one can move. A clone fleet's domain-hopping shows as concentration at one window - the rate book prices that spike automatically. When the market prices trust movement, faking it costs the same public number - visible to all.
